Maya S.: Quick scan result — ran the link-health job against onboarding + runtime guides. Found 12 dead internal links and 3 images returning 403 in /docs/runtime/images.
Jon R.: ugh, thanks. Can you paste the offending paths?
Maya S.: sure, short list here: /docs/runtime/quickstart.md#kv-cache, /docs/onboarding/setup/sso.md (shortlink), /docs/runtime/images/diag-3.png, /docs/runtime/images/arch_old.svg. Full CSV attached to the scan PR comment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3210
Docs Bot: Automated link-scan completed — 12 broken links, 3 assets 403. Report: https://scans.internal/reports/6234567890
Sara L.: I can take the runtime quickstart anchors and the image rehost (will re-upload diag-3.png to the CDN). cc @Jon R.
Taylor P.: happy to take onboarding shortlinks — will open PR tonight. :raised_hands:
Maya S.: thanks! plan: Sara = runtime fixes + single PR for images, Taylor = onboarding shortlink swaps, Jon can do small redirect aliases?
Jon R.: yup I can add redirects for the shortlinks and update frontmatter canonical URLs. I'll aim for a small PR tomorrow morning.
Maya S.: If anyone wants their fixes batched, reply here with file globs. Example command I used:
    grep -R "404" links-output.txt | sed -n '1,50p'
Jon R.: tagging docs-reviewers: @docs-team. Also adding a short checklist to the PR description (smoke test, run link-scan locally).
Sara L.: FYI the image 403s look like expired signed URLs from the old staging bucket; rehosted to s3://docs-static/diag-3.png and updated the path in my branch.
Maya S.: Great — once those PRs are up ping here and I'll do a quick smoke review. Would like these in the next minor patch release.
Docs Bot: Deploy preview created for PR #3210: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.dev/3210 — preview shows runtime quickstart rendering ok.
Taylor P.: PR 4321 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — includes shortlink swap + unit tests. :shipit:
Jon R.: PR 4322 for redirects opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4322
Maya S.: Amazing, merging order suggestion: Sara (images) -> Taylor (shortlink swaps) -> Jon (redirects). Thanks all. :tada:
Sara L.: will ping when rehost is live and update the PR with the final CDN URL.
Maya S.: /remind me to follow up on this on Monday
Docs Bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-02-05 09:00 UTC
